title: Downside Protection Terms Carried on Refined Fuels and Propane Programmes
content:
Downside protection is a term of the pre-buy booking on the programmes that carry it under Refined Fuels and Propane Accounts. The catalogue fixes, for each programme, whether the protection is offered at all, the fee per gallon it is sold at, and the floor percentage of the booked price that the protection is written against.

| Programme | Downside protection | Fee, USD per gallon | Floor, percent of the booked price |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Will-Call Propane Account | not offered | 0.00 | 0 |
| Keep-Full Automatic Delivery Account | not offered | 0.00 | 0 |
| Budget Payment Plan Account | not offered | 0.00 | 0 |
| Contract Gallon Pre-Buy Account | offered | 0.12 | 90 |
| Bulk Farm Fuel Delivery Account | offered | 0.09 | 92 |
| Cardtrol Fleet Fueling Account | not offered | 0.00 | 0 |

## Basis questions on the terms

**Which programmes carry it.** Two of the six: the Contract Gallon Pre-Buy Account and the Bulk Farm Fuel Delivery Account. On the other four the catalogue writes the protection as not offered, the fee at 0.00 USD per gallon and the floor at 0 percent.

**What the fee column is.** The charge per gallon the protection is sold at, standing at 0.12 USD per gallon on the Contract Gallon Pre-Buy Account and 0.09 USD per gallon on the Bulk Farm Fuel Delivery Account.

**What the floor column is.** The share of the price the gallons were booked at that the protection is written against, standing at 90 percent on the Contract Gallon Pre-Buy Account and 92 percent on the Bulk Farm Fuel Delivery Account. The Bulk Farm Fuel Delivery Account therefore carries both the cheaper fee and the higher floor of the two.
